[color=#ffff00][head=3]Section 9: Erotic Roleplay (ERP) Rules[/head][/color]
[color=#a4885c]9.1[/color] Erotic Roleplay (ERP) does not take precedence over your assigned duties. If your role requires your attention or you are requested to perform your job, you must respond or return to your duties as soon as reasonably possible. ★
[color=#a4885c]9.2[/color] ERP must not be used or offered as bait to lure, ambush, or kill another player. ★
[color=#a4885c]9.3[/color] Do not harass, ridicule, or shame other players for their consensual roleplay preferences. ★
[color=#a4885c]9.4[/color] All ERP-related dialogue or roleplay must be conducted using the subtle (-) or whisper commands. ★
[color=#a4885c]9.4A[/color] When engaging in ERP, ensure that any device capable of transmitting your voice (such as shuttle consoles, HandiComm, or similar communication systems) is disabled to avoid disturbing other players. ★
[color=#a4885c]9.5[/color] Do not spam or excessively use radio channels for NSFW topics. This does not prohibit discussing such topics altogether; however, repeated hornyposting, shitposting, depression posting, or other disruptive behavior is prohibited. ★
[color=#a4885c]9.6[/color] Do not engage in or publicly discuss extreme sexual fetishes. Public spaces include radio channels, spoken dialogue in public areas, overt public actions, or any activity visible through cameras. ★
[color=#a4885c]9.7[/color] ERP involving non-sentient creatures is prohibited. This includes creatures that resemble beasts, even if they may later become sentient. ★★
[color=#a4885c]9.8[/color] When roleplaying another player's character, you must obtain out-of-character (OOC) consent from that character's owner before engaging in ERP involving them. ★★
[color=#a4885c]9.9[/color] Be mindful of both in-character (IC) and out-of-character (OOC) consent. If your OOC consent is violated or disregarded, immediately submit an Ahelp or open an administrative ticket. ★★★
[color=#a4885c]9.10[/color] Extreme roleplay themes, including but not limited to snuff, abuse, non-consensual scenarios (noncon), and similar content, are only permitted when all participating parties have provided prior OOC consent. If you are uncertain whether a scenario is permitted, contact an administrator through an Ahelp. Keep such roleplay private. ★★★
[color=#a4885c]9.11[/color] ERP must not take place in public areas. Ensure you are in a private, secure location, such as a personal ship, a lockable room, dormitories, or another secluded area.
[color=#a4885c]9.11A[/color] If another player discovers your ERP and requests that you stop or relocate, you must either move to a different private location or cease the activity. ★
